title: Regiment and Clock
author: Ulyana Iversen
blurb: Lena Whitlock, an apprentice clockmaker summoned to repair the observatory's master clock, keeps a low profile and busy hands. Then the army requisitions the town and the ledger with all the names — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must finish the work while the workshop still stands, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
